name: Early Access Warning

buttons.path: UI Canvas/Early Access Warning/Background/Early Access Warning/Yes
buttons.label: Weiter

texts:
Liebe Könige und Königinnen, 
eine kurze Anmerkung von uns, den Entwicklern des Spiels: Wir haben unser Bestes getan, um diese Version von Thronefall so gut wie möglich zu machen. Bitte bedenkt jedoch, dass Thronefall sich noch im Early Access befindet - es ist noch nicht perfekt und wir arbeiten hart daran, dass die Verteidigung eures kleinen Königreichs noch mehr Spaß macht. Euer Feedback ist ein unverzichtbarer Teil dieses Prozesses, deshalb würden wir uns freuen, eure Anregungen in unserem Discord zu lesen (den Link findet ihr auf der Steam-Seite). Dies ist auch der perfekte Ort, um Bugs zu melden, Strategien zu diskutieren und sich mit anderen Spielern auszutauschen. 

Noch eine Sache: Momentan ist Thronefall ein kurzes Spiel - aus diesem Grund auch der kleine Preis. Im Laufe des Early Access werden wir weitere Inhalte ergänzen, die mehr Spielzeit und neue Spielmöglichkeiten bieten. Schaut einfach hin und wieder mal vorbei, um zu sehen, was es Neues gibt!  

Alles Gute 
Jonas und Paul

texts:
Bem-vindo ao modo infinito de Thronefall.

Enfrente ondas de inimigos geradas proceduralmente em vários níveis que se tornam progressivamente mais e mais difíceis.

Você mantém todas as suas vantagens dos níveis anteriores, mas uma vez que você perde, é o fim e você tem que começar do zero. Até onde você pode chegar?

Atenção! Este modo contém spoilers para a campanha principal (recomendamos que você jogue isso primeiro).

buttons.path: UI Canvas/Eternal Trials Season 04 Pop Up/Background/Early Access Warning/Yes
buttons.label: Continue

texts:
Dear Kings and Queens, 

Your hichscore and your ongoing save file for this mode have been archived!

While we won't have recurring "seasons" in a traditional sense, we're adopting the model to allow for big balancing patches such as this one.

The difficulty ramps up faster now, but enemy waves should also feel much more consistent and predictable. We added an enemy preview and the possibility to disable unwanted perks before entering a level. For a full list of all changes, please check out the patch notes on Steam.

All the best 
Jonas & Paul

texts:
Mini-modes are very difficult, often almost puzzle-like, bonus challenges with modified rules that heavily mix up the gameplay.

<bold>We highly recommended that you complete the main campaign before playing any mini-modes due to their high difficulty!</bold>

Every mini-mode is different and has unique rules to explore, requiring you to think outside the box and challenge your knowledge of the game. Completing mini-modes is entirely optional and does not grant any rewards or achievements. They’re just here for fun if you'd like to accept the challenge—but be warned, it's not for the faint of heart!

name: Update 1.1

buttons.path: UI Canvas/Update 1.1/Background/Text/Yes
buttons.label: Weiter

texts:
Dear Kings and Queens, 
We just rolled out the first regular Update for Thronefall (Early Access Version 1.1). For a comprehensive list of changes please have a look at the full patch notes in the Steam Forums or our Discord. Here’s a quick summary of what has changed: 

• Key Rebinding: It is now possible to set up your own control configurations. By default everything should work like it used to, but due to technical reasons you might have to rebind movement to the W A S D keys if you were used to it. This is because there’s only one slot to bind per action per input device and the default binding for movement is the arrow keys. On the upside a lot more controllers should be supported now. 

• Upcoming Night Info: You can now see a summary of the enemies attacking during the next night in the pause menu. There you can also read a quick description of each enemy which should help figuring out what preparations to take against it. 

• Balancing Changes: A massive amount of balancing tweaks and changes based on your feedback. Impossible to list everything here, please have a look at the full patch notes for details. 

That’s it for this update – now we’re off to work on new gameplay content. We’re excited to share the next level and maybe even a little surprise with you soon. 

All the best
Jonas & Paul
